name: Liquid Inference (Architect)
description: An inference exchange that auctions requests among model providers.
overview: The operator says new workspaces receive starting credit for initial requests without a card. Its amount, expiry and eligibility are not published on the cited page; treat it as a finite starting grant, not a monthly allowance. Auction prices and exchange fees apply. This is distinct from Liquid AI and its model console. No account or inference was tested.
free_access: Starting credit for new workspaces; no card
Market prices and exchange fees apply
Distinct from Liquid AI / Liquid Console
notes: Base URL https://router.inference.ai.exchange/v1. Offers, balances and model identities were not independently verified.
